items.html:
Floris Jansen is a right arm fast medium bowler  who  swings  the
ball with some effect. Very successful in Dutch domestic cricket,
and his 3-8 was crictical in  the  Netherlands  defeat of   South
Africa  in  1994, in the course of which he took his 100th wicket
for his country.  He quit his career in 1996 after repeated
injuries.
